Nothing here is a commitment. The point of the issue is to hold the evidence
until someone has time to decide whether it is worth doing at all - closing it
as "not worth it" is a good outcome.

## Evidence

     a diagnostic, a file and line. Concrete beats plausible - a hunch with no
     evidence usually turns out to be a different problem. -->

## Where it likely lives

<!-- Best guess at the files or the pipeline stage. Guessing wrong is fine and
     still saves the next person a search. -->

## Options considered
